pierMorning: 1. Sunday 08:40, 360 px Android in a splash pouch. The app cold-starts on Vento (measured: a reload lands on Vento in 1.7 s on the Chrome dev server and 4.8 s on the WebKit dev server; not production figures). The hero reads 'In corso · Domenica AM 8–14'. Read twice: it says 'in progress' before the boats leave, and 8–14 is not the outing (9:00–12:30).
2. I want to show the crew where the wind sits against Isola del Porco. Thumb up to 'Mappa' at y=177 of 780, the top quarter of the screen: tap 1. The cold start had put the switch back on Numeri.
3. The map opens on 8:00, before the boats go, because the current hour wins (firstMapHour). Tap '10': tap 2.

4. Three markers: 15, 15, 15, r42. The numbers are 13.6 px and the gusts and names 11 px. Held up to twelve kids at arm's length, nobody can read them. Read twice. Tap 'Numeri' to get the 40 px number back: tap 3.

5. 12:40, boats in since 12:30, lunch on the pier. I glance at Home for the afternoon and get 'Vento · Dom AM' with the morning's numbers. Read twice. Tap the Vento line (tap 4), one swipe to the week, tap 'Domenica PM' (tap 5). The previous build had switched to PM at 12:00: zero taps.
6. 13:05 on Home: 'NW 10 kn raffiche 22', then a thermometer and '17 °C', then 'Temporali possibili' in third place. Read twice.
7. 18:05, setting tomorrow's crews: 'Lun AM … Pioggia · 17 °C'. One glance and zero taps, but 'Pioggia' may come from the 8:00 or the 13:00 hour, when nobody is on the water.

Count: 5 taps and 1 swipe, against 0 for the same information in the previous build (the map did not exist then); 6 moments read twice; about 40 s of screen time, which is an estimate, not a measurement.

blockers.title: The six-hour morning row: at 320 px and 200 % text the hour numbers run together ('2015152015 15', '17°17°17°…') and the map's hour buttons overlap; at 360 px and 150 % the buttons are 37 px wide
blockers.evidence: WIND_SESSION_HOURS.AM went from four hours to six (src/domain/windConfig.ts:114-117), and HourCell gained an icon and a temperature (src/features/weather/WeatherScreen.tsx:220-230). The row is repeat(n, minmax(0, 1fr)) with no wrap (WeatherScreen.tsx:557). Measured on pixel-7 and on iphone-13 WebKit, with the same figures. At 320 px/200 % each cell is 32 px wide, and every knot, gust and temperature span is 34-41 px wide and reaches into the next cell. In Mappa the buttons are 41 px wide in 32 px columns. The layout audit (tests/e2e/layout-audit.ts) reports 'li is wider inside (41) than outside (32)' for all six, '"17°" overlaps "17°"' and '"17°" is under button[Ore 8 …]'. At 360 px/150 % the buttons are 37×183 px, under the rulebook's 40 px floor for dense groups. The ink gap between temperatures is 1.3 px at 390 px/200 % and 4.2 px at 360 px/175 %. The suite's 320/200 journey (tests/e2e/weather.spec.ts:776-) checks only Saturday PM (five hours) and only sideways scroll, so it stays green. Screens: test-results/nostromo/pixel-7-am-320-200-numeri.png, iphone-13-am-320-200-numeri.png, pixel-7-am-320-200-mappa.png.
blockers.reproduction: test-results/nostromo/nostromo.spec.ts, tests 'field: six AM hours at 320 px 200%' and 'second: AM numbers run together …' (config test-results/nostromo/pw.config.ts, projects pixel-7 and iphone-13). blockers.specRef: docs/design/06_DESIGN_RULEBOOK.md §1 (data correctness first), R04 (active areas must not overlap; 40 px floor for dense groups), R05, §5 (320 px at 200 %: content preserved); precedent FUX-19, a round-2 blocker for a number broken in a week cell
blockers.proposedChange: When a cell is narrower than about 40 px, put the hour row on two lines of three, or drop the per-hour icon and temperature (the 'Ora per ora' list has them). Extend the 320/200 journey to Sunday AM, with an ink-gap check per number and the audit's overlap check.

importantFindings.title: FUX-16 has come back: from 12:00 to 12:59 Home and the hero show the finished morning, and the test that guarded the fix was rewritten
importantFindings.evidence: nextDecisionSlot moves on in the window's last hour (src/domain/wind.ts:686-695). That hour is now 13:00, because AM ends at 14, while the outing ends at 12:30 (windConfig.ts:108-113). Measured on both engines with the fixture: on Sunday at 12:10 and 12:40, Home shows 'Vento · Dom AM · incerto Variabile 17 kn raffiche 42' and the hero 'In corso · Domenica AM'; at 13:05 both show 'Dom PM'. In the src/domain/wind.test.ts diff, the case 'in its last hour: the afternoon' moved from 12:50 to 13:50 Rome, and the 13:30 'at lunch' case became a 14:30 'during the afternoon' case (wind.test.ts:962-970). The old 12:50 assertion would now fail, and nothing tests that moment any more. Before this change the switch came at 12:00.
importantFindings.reproduction: test-results/nostromo/nostromo.spec.ts, test 'field: Home through the Sunday lunch and evening' (pixel-7 and iphone-13): clock Sun 8 Nov 12:40 Rome, reload, open Vento, back to Home. Expected: 'Vento · Dom PM', the decision of the moment, as between 12:00 and 12:59 in the previous build. Observed: 'Vento · Dom AM'.
importantFindings.specRef: docs/working/WEATHER_PROPOSAL.md §2 ('The answer without a tap', 'The decision of the moment'); round-1 FUX-16
importantFindings.proposedChange: Keep the outing's times (9:00-12:30, 15:00-18:00) separate from the display window (8-14, 14-19). Base the decision slot on the outing's end, and use the window only for the hour row and the map. Put a 12:40 case back in the table.

importantFindings.title: The trend hours count in every headline: Home, the hero, the week cell and the thunder line now describe 8-14 and 14-19, not the outing
importantFindings.evidence: summariseHours runs over hoursInSlot (src/domain/wind.ts:452-522, 697-706). The mean wind, highest gust, worst wet sky, thunder flag and temperature range all include 8:00 and 13:00 (AM) and 14:00 and 18:00 (PM): 2 of 6 and 2 of 5 hours with no boat on the water. The comment on WEATHER_KINDS justifies 'worst wet' with 'an hour of rain matters on the water' (windConfig.ts:261-266). I overrode the sky and measured on pixel-7. Clear skies from 8 to 12, rain only at 13:00 and 9 °C only at 8:00 give the week cell 'Domenica 8 AM: … Pioggia, da 9 a 17 gradi' and the hero 'Pioggia · 9–17 °C', for an outing forecast dry at 17 °C. Thunder only at 18:00 on Saturday gives Home 'Temporali possibili' for Sat PM; the old 14-18 window left 18:00 out. Thunder only at 8:00 on Sunday gives the hero 'Temporali possibili' for an outing that is clear from 9 to 12. The owner asked to see the trend. Proposal §6 item 7 records the window, but not that it changes what the headline numbers mean.
importantFindings.reproduction: test-results/nostromo/nostromo.spec.ts, tests 'second: rain at 13:00 only, the outing dry' and 'field: a storm at 8:00 …'. Each routes the api.open-meteo.com weather_code request itself, on top of routeWeather.
importantFindings.specRef: AGENTS.md §14 (a choice that changes UX or domain semantics goes to the owner); docs/working/WEATHER_PROPOSAL.md §6 item 7
importantFindings.proposedChange: Summarise only the outing's hours and show the extra hours muted in the row. Otherwise, ask the owner which meaning he intended and record the answer.

importantFindings.title: At 360 px the map's wind numbers are 13.6 px and its gusts and names 11 px; for Derive these numbers appear nowhere else, so the code comment's justification does not hold
importantFindings.evidence: Computed sizes at 360 px, the same on both engines: knots 13.63 px, gust 'r32' 11 px, place names 11 px, clock badge 11.6 px. At 320 px: 12.5 px and 11 px. WindZoneMap.tsx:26-32 says 'the same numbers are … larger, in the Numeri view'. But PlaceRows renders only for Cabinati (WeatherScreen.tsx:574), with half-day values, not hourly ones, so Derive's hourly numbers per place exist only at these sizes. The Derive points are 0.72 km (Isola del Porco to Punta Rossa) to 2.14 km apart. Five of the seven models have grids of 7 km or more (gridKm in windConfig), so the three markers mostly repeat one number, as proposal §8 admits. Held up to a crew, the 40 px number in Numeri is readable and the map's numbers are not.
importantFindings.reproduction: test-results/nostromo/nostromo.spec.ts, test 'field: Derive and Cabinati map at 360 px …'. Its mapAudit logs each span's computed font-size. Screen: test-results/nostromo/pixel-7-map-360-derive.png.
importantFindings.specRef: docs/design/06_DESIGN_RULEBOOK.md R05 (12-13 px badges only when they do not carry essential information alone)
importantFindings.proposedChange: Set a floor of 16 px for the map's knots and 13 px for gusts and names. On Derive, keep the zone's large number above the map, or show a single marker when the points do not differ.

importantFindings.title: Cabinati at 320 and 360 px: a place name lies over a neighbour's marker, so a number reads under the wrong name
importantFindings.evidence: Measured overlaps at 360 px: the 'Caprera sud' name over Liscia di Vacca's marker, 22.7×11.2 px; the 'Liscia di Vacca' name and Cannigione's marker, 11.4×6.9 px; the 'La Maddalena nord' name and Spargi's marker, 20.4×4.1 px. At 320 px the same three overlaps are 25.3×11.4, 17.9×7.5 and 24.8×4.9 px. Names are drawn last (WindZoneMap.tsx:186), so 'Caprera sud' covers Liscia di Vacca's arrow and sits on the same line as its '15 r32' (test-results/nostromo/pixel-7-map-320-cabinati.png). WebKit gives the same figures. The fixture gives these places equal values, so the misreading cannot be seen in the suite. With real values that differ, 'Caprera sud 15 r32' would be Liscia di Vacca's wind.
importantFindings.reproduction: test-results/nostromo/nostromo.spec.ts, test 'fifth: Cabinati map at 320 px' and the 360 px map test: open Vento, choose Cabinati, choose Mappa.
importantFindings.proposedChange: Give each point a label side in windConfig, or run a simple collision pass. Assert in the map journey that no marker overlaps a name at 320 and 360 px.
